name: expanding-action
title: Expanding Action
summary: A compact action that transforms in place to reveal two to four related choices while preserving context.
useWhen: A compact trigger should reveal two to four closely related choices in place.
The choices should remain visually connected to the action that revealed them.
avoidWhen: The choices perform navigation or require a long menu.
The interaction contains a destructive action that needs deliberate confirmation.
capabilities: Shared-surface transition between trigger and choices
accessibility: Uses button semantics and visible keyboard focus states for the trigger, back control, and choices.
Keep choice labels specific enough to describe the resulting action.

motion.purpose: Preserve spatial continuity as one compact action transforms into its related choices.
motion.reducedMotion: Respect the user's reduced-motion preference while preserving the expanded and collapsed state change.
